name: Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE)
description: A 30-item questionnaire measuring cognitive impairment in clinical settings, covering orientation, registration, attention/calculation, recall, and language. One of the most widely used cognitive tests worldwide.
reputation: Extensively validated; standard tool in geriatric and neurology settings globally.
notes: Copyright held by PAR Inc.; insensitive to mild impairment; education and age biases documented.
